summaries.zh: 阿里巴巴开源项目 open-code-review，是一款快速高效、经阿里规模验证的代码审查工具。它采用确定性流水线加 LLM Agent 的混合架构，可提供精确的行级评论，内置多语言规则集，覆盖 NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入等，并兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic。项目使用 Go 语言，获 23072 Star、1706 Fork。
summaries.en: Alibaba’s open-code-review is a fast, scalable code review tool built on a hybrid architecture combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM agent. It provides precise line-level comments and includes a built-in multi-language ruleset for issues such as NPE, thread safety, XSS, and SQL injection. It is compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic. Written in Go, the repository has about 23,072 stars and 1,706 forks.
